description: Convert CSV to JSON with a real parser that handles quoted commas, escaped quotes and multi-line fields.

faqs.a: Yes. The parser understands quoted fields, so commas inside quotes don't split the row, "" becomes a literal quote, and newlines inside quotes stay in the field.
faqs.q: Does it handle commas inside quoted fields?

faqs.a: The first row is always treated as the header row, and each later row becomes an object keyed by those headers.
They become empty strings, and extra values beyond the header count are ignored.
faqs.q: What if some rows have missing or extra columns?

howto: Paste your CSV — the first row must be headers.
Quoted commas, escaped quotes and line breaks inside fields are parsed correctly.
Download the result as a .json file.
title: CSV to JSON Converter
